welcome:
Welcome to Daily Close (Birana Technology, Addis Ababa)!
Track credit sales, bank receipts, and daily collections in ETB.
ask_invite_code: Please enter your registration invite code to connect your account:
registered: Registration successful! You are connected as {role} for {tenant}.
invalid_invite_code: Invalid or expired invite code. Please contact your company administrator.
quick_entry_gap_warning: ⚠️ Sequence gap detected! Missing invoice numbers: {gaps}
quick_entry_duplicate_error: ✕ Rejection: Invoice number {invoice_number} already exists for your business.
quick_entry_syntax_error:
✕ Format error. Please use: 'INV381 | Retailer Name | Amount | due 30d'
Example: INV-402 | Abebe Grocery | 150000 | due 30d
photo_received_l4:
📷 Payment screenshot received and stored as Evidence Level L4 (unverified).
Proposed payment of {amount_etb} ETB created and queued for review.

⚠️ Non-Negotiable Rule: L4 evidence is NEVER counted as confirmed paid until verified against a bank/Telebirr statement.
match_accepted_unverified:
✓ Marked as accepted_unverified (L4).
Note: This amount is NEVER counted as confirmed paid in totals or accountant exports.
only_owner_can_accept_unverified: ✕ Permission denied: Only owners can mark L4 items as accepted_unverified.
l4_cannot_confirm: ✕ Rule 2 Violation: L4 screenshot evidence cannot be confirmed directly. The owner may mark it 'accepted_unverified' or match it with an imported bank statement line.
help_text:
Daily Close Commands:
• Quick Entry: 'INV381 | Retailer | Amount | due 30d'
• Photo Upload: Send a receipt photo for L4 review
• /brief: Morning collections brief
• /aging: Receivables aging breakdown
• /review: Pending match review queue
• /lang [en|am]: Switch language
